# The register of economic operators FerroFED was supplied to or by, kept by
# its manufacturer, Cadasto B.V. (Regulation (EU) 2025/327 Art 35,
# Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 Art 23). This copy is the register's format and
# holds no row: the rows name customers and their addresses, which the
# manufacturer keeps outside the public repository, in a private copy of
# this file under git. scripts/checks/economic-operators.sh refuses a row
# here, and checks the private copy with --register.
# One row per supply under a contract, appended and never rewritten. The
# only change to a row is filling its keep_until; a row leaves the register
# only after that date. A public download, which names no recipient, is no
# row (docs/post-market.md, The register of economic operators).
# Columns:
#   id             E-<year>-<number>, in the order the supplies were made
#   direction      supplied-to (Art 35(b), Art 23(1)(b)) or supplied-by
#   supplied       the date of the supply, YYYY-MM-DD
#   operator       the economic operator's name (Art 23(1))
#   address        its address (Art 23(1))
#   role           its role under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 Art 3(13):
#                  manufacturer, authorised-representative, importer,
#                  distributor, fulfilment-service-provider or other
#   versions       the FerroFED versions supplied, comma-separated
#   form           what was supplied, comma-separated: source, binaries,
#                  gateway-image, console-image
#   member_states  the Member States where the contract has it made
#                  available or put into service, two-letter country codes,
#                  comma-separated; may be empty on a supplied-by row
#   contract       the contract's reference in the manufacturer's records
#   keep_until     empty until known; then the later of 10 years after the
#                  supply (Art 23(2)) and 10 years after the last placing on
#                  the market under the declaration of conformity that covers
#                  the versions (Art 35), YYYY-MM-DD
